summary: Lanvin Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) disclosing board changes effective September 30, 2026: independent directors Mitchell Alan Garber and Chao Zou resigned for personal reasons, with no disagreement cited. CFO Xi Luo, in the role since June 1, 2026, was appointed a director, succeeding Zou. Jennifer Fleiss joined the Audit Committee and Max Chen became Compensation Committee Chair, succeeding Garber. The company continues searching for an additional independent director. No deal terms, prices, advisors or premiums were disclosed; watch board independence and governance/audit oversight through the transition and any further resignations.
